climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A northern Mendocino County AVA about 150 miles north of San Francisco, covering Round and Williams Valleys. It spans 38,000 acres yet had only 2 acres under vine at the outset.
